items.title: 40-Story Skyscraper Proposed Near Civic Center, San Francisco
items.summary: Initial permits have been filed for a potential 40-story mixed-use skyscraper at 38 8th Street in San Francisco's Mid-Market District . The high-rise proposal would replace a surface parking lot at the corner of 8th Street and Stevenson with nearly three hundred apartments across from the Civic Center neighborhood. Manna Capital is the project developer, filing on behalf of the property owner, Napa County -based Aslanian 2006 Revocable Trust.

items.title: YIMBY Tours 730 Stanyan Street in Haight-Ashbury, San Francisco
items.summary: The affordable housing complex is now open at 730 Stanyan Street in San Francisco’s Haight-Ashbury neighborhood. Recently, YIMBY toured the building with project team leaders from OMA , Y.A. Studio , and the Chinatown Community Development Center . Even before opening, all 160 units have been fully leased, and the ground-floor early childcare center is near completion.

items.title: Permits Filed For Performing Arts Center in SoMa, San Francisco
items.summary: Permits have been filed to renovate an existing industrial structure into a performing arts space at 262 7th Street in SoMa , San Francisco . The conversion would add a gallery space and theater, contributing to the SOMA Pilipinas cultural district. The development is led by a partnership with the Asian Pacific Islander Cultural Center and Kularts.
